Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Fire Spinning And The Paradise Circus", "body": "Oliver Brusca, who records as VOLO, recounts five months in Southeast Asia, two months in Indonesia and two months in Thailand, where fire spinning became his main new inspiration. He traces the start to Fire Drums, a northern California festival with a fire circle of about a hundred people, where friends pushed him to try it. In the town of Pai he walked up to a venue called Paradise Circus, was invited to perform that same night with no tryout, and joined two fire shows a week. Both men describe the practice as an immediate flow state because the body is so averse to being set on fire."}, {"title": "Talent, Skill And Permission To Create", "body": "Chance Garton shows off the Synergy coloring book Oliver mailed him and argues that coloring pages give people a no wrong answers way back into making things, since fear of doing it wrong is what stops most people from starting. He contends that the word talent functions as an excuse, and prefers skill or aptitude because those name time, effort and care. He extends the point to festival culture, where he says hero worship and huge crowds create a dispersion of care, while Oliver says he is far more drawn to smaller, family sized gatherings where everyone ends up knowing each other."}, {"title": "Cosmogenesis And The Voice From The Stars", "body": "Oliver finished the album Cosmogenesis while traveling, with one more single due in two weeks and the full release within about two months. On stream he previews the ambient opener Invocation and the title track, which features vocals from his friend Zan Prana. Asked what the name means, he describes walking to the edge of music festivals at night, sober or on cacao, looking up at the stars and hearing a deep, echoing voice telling him this is what he is meant to be doing. Chance separately gives his own view that the 432 hertz question matters less than conspiracy culture claims."}, {"title": "Chronos, Kairos And The Eternal Return", "body": "Chance lays out two Greek words for time: chronos, the measured, clock bound, cyclical time most people take as the only kind, and kairos, which lexicons render as the right or critical moment and which he treats as subjective time, measured by how much you actually grow. Oliver links kairos to curiosity, the thing that carried him to Thailand and a circus. Chance also argues there was no in the beginning moment, only an eternal return, a phrase Oliver liked enough to name a track after. They discuss the documentary The Atlantis Puzzle, Plato's wording, and the Richat structure in the Sahara."}, {"title": "Bali, Waterfalls And The Ancestral River", "body": "Oliver describes Bali as spiritually upfront, with dense temples and daily offerings of flowers, incense and crackers laid out with visible heartfelt intention. He recounts a guided ceremony where you place ten offerings at nature shrines and pass through waterfalls with assigned purposes, one for emotional release and one for joy, plus a Balinese reader whose specific questions dissolved his skepticism and left him processing for days. Chance then shares a client's emailed feedback from his biofield tuning practice and describes what he calls the ancestral river, paternal and maternal bands he says sit about ten inches off the body."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Oliver Brusca - aka VOLO - is a dynamic creator through many mediums, but most notably music production. With diverse tracks that invoke a deeper breath through ambience or inspire a triumphant energy in their orchestral power, the spirit and energy of VOLO's sound is one thousand percent Vibe Rant. Tonight we'll catch up with the traveling troubadour and see where the conversation flow takes us.

It's really interesting, that's how I like to do it.", "author": "Oliver Brusca (VOLO)", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "I don't actually think that the 432 thing is as big a deal as conspiracy culture makes it out to be, but that's my opinion.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I look at the stars and I hear this voice very clearly telling me, yo, this is what you're meant to be doing, no questions about it.", "author": "Oliver Brusca (VOLO)", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "Why I think the subjective time is the real time is because it's measured by how you evolve as a soul and as a being, and how you grow, how your perspective or consciousness expands.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "One of them was an emotional release waterfall where you go into the waterfall and you're letting the water just pummel you, and then you're supposed to just let out any emotion, any sounds.", "author": "Oliver Brusca (VOLO)", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "The ancestor energy flow thing, we are a river of energy. It's a continuum, there's not really a separation on the lineage, we're all connected.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "That was kind of my intention for the book being called Synergy, because I feel like all these art forms are a synergy and they all inform each other in a different way.", "author": "Oliver Brusca (VOLO)", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "To just reorient ourselves or ground ourselves back into the real meaning of life, which is life, AKA creation.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
